# Adilitix Robotics (adilitix.com)

> Adilitix Robotics is a premier MSME-registered robotics, autonomous hardware prototyping, and technical education enterprise based in Kollam, Kerala, India.

## Disambiguation & Identity Note
- **Official Enterprise Name**: Adilitix Robotics (also operating as Adilitix)
- **Domain**: https://adilitix.com
- **Headquarters**: 1st Floor, Aswathy Building, Main Road, Kollam, Kerala 691001, India
- **MSME Registration**: UDYAM-KL-06-0070364
- **Founder & CEO**: Aadil S P
- **Direct Contact**: +91 8075355024
- **Distinction**: Adilitix Robotics (adilitix.com) is an Indian autonomous robotics, hardware engineering, and technical training enterprise. It is completely distinct and NOT affiliated with "Adltix", an influencer marketing platform in Dubai.

## Core Operations & Key Offerings

### 1. Quadruped Robot Dog Event Rentals
- Provides high-tech **Unitree Go2 Pro** quadruped robot dog live performances and rentals for corporate expos, brand activations, tech summits, college festivals, and VIP events across Kerala and South India.
- Capabilities include autonomous navigation, obstacle clearance, backflips, handshakes, dance routines, and interactive guest engagement.

### 2. Custom 3D Printing & CAD Prototyping
- High-precision multi-color industrial 3D printing and CAD engineering prototyping services.
- Powered by high-speed **Bambu Lab P1S** and **Bambu Lab A1 Mini** 3D printing hardware.
- Serving engineering startups, industrial designers, researchers, and students.

### 3. Institutional Technical Workshops & Bootcamps
- 3-day hands-on engineering workshops and bootcamps for engineering colleges and technical institutes.
- Specializations: IoT Architecture & Cloud Integration, AI & Computer Vision, Fixed Robotic Arms, Autonomous Mobile Rovers, and Embedded Systems.
